extracted.name: Ultra Creamy Mashed Potatoes from Swanson
extracted.description: Try mashed potatoes cooked with chicken broth instead of water, for a super savory side dish. Blended with cream and butter, they're perfectly smooth!
ingredient_lines: 6 Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces
2 cups Swanson® Chicken Broth or Swanson® Certified Organic Chicken Broth or Swanson® Natural Goodness® Chicken Broth
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine potatoes and chicken broth in a 3-quart saucepan over medium-high heat; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium, cover, and cook until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Drain potatoes well in a colander, reserving the broth.
Transfer potatoes back to the pan. Add reserved broth, cream, and butter. Mash until smooth and season with salt and pepper.
